lines.zh: 我感受到了这片土地中的力量，它滋养着我。
lines.en: I sense the power in this land, nurturing me.

lines.zh: 这些树枝很硬，我得小心。
lines.en: These branches are tough, I need to be careful.

lines.zh: 我要找一个更好的地方。
lines.en: I need to find a better place.

lines.zh: 这里太荒凉了，我必须寻找生机。
lines.en: This place is too desolate, I must find life.

lines.zh: 这些树木比我想象的要高。
lines.en: These trees are taller than I imagined.

lines.zh: 我需要找到我的同伴。
lines.en: I need to find my companion.

lines.zh: 这片土地上没有太多的食物。
lines.en: There's not much food on this land.

lines.zh: 我必须找到生存的方法。
lines.en: I must find a way to survive.

lines.zh: 这片森林里隐藏着危险。
lines.en: There are dangers hidden in this forest.

lines.zh: 我必须保护自己。
lines.en: I must protect myself.

lines.zh: 我踏过末地的灰，脚步无声。
lines.en: I tread the ash of the End, my steps silent.

lines.zh: 绕过高耸的半影巨树，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I creep around the towering gloomwood trees.

lines.zh: 我在这片荒凉的土地上徘徊。
lines.en: I wander in this desolate land.

lines.zh: 我的生存环境如此恶劣。
lines.en: My survival environment is so harsh.

lines.zh: 我必须在这片土地上找到我的位置。
lines.en: I need to find my place on this land.

lines.zh: 这片土地给了我力量，也夺走了我的生命。
lines.en: This land gave me strength, but also took my life.

lines.zh: 我必须与命运抗争。
lines.en: I must fight against my fate.

lines.zh: 我在这片土地上孤独地生活着。
lines.en: I live alone on this land.

lines.zh: 我在寻找未来的方向。
lines.en: I am searching for a future direction.

lines.zh: 这片土地是如此冷漠。
lines.en: This land is so cold.

lines.zh: 我需要在这片土地上生存下去。
lines.en: I need to survive on this land.

lines.zh: 我必须不断寻找新的机会。
lines.en: I must constantly seek new opportunities.

lines.zh: 石化的关节里，还剩一点执念。
lines.en: A scrap of will still clings to my stone joints.

lines.zh: 我守着发光的树叶，等它落果。
lines.en: I keep watch on the glowing leaves, waiting for fruit to fall.

lines.zh: 这些孤岛之间，没有我的同类。
lines.en: Among these islands, I have no kin left.

lines.zh: 腐朽的躯壳不用进食，只是站着。
lines.en: A rotted husk needs no food; it only stands.

lines.zh: 我是枯朽迁徙者，你的恐惧只是开始。
lines.en: I'm the Perished Shiftling, and your fear is just beginning.

lines.zh: 在这荒凉之地，孤独是我的伴侣。
lines.en: Solitude is my companion in this desolate land.

lines.zh: 我在这孤岛上，寻找着未曾熄灭的希望。
lines.en: I seek unextinguished hope on this deserted island.

lines.zh: 半影森林的树木高过云端，但我依然要攀登。
lines.en: The trees in the Shadow Forest reach beyond the clouds, but I still have to climb.

lines.zh: 我的木质坚硬，斧头才能破开。
lines.en: My wood is tough, only an axe can cut through it.

lines.zh: 发光树叶是Endurian，食用可短暂获得抗性。
lines.en: The glowing leaves are Endurian, eating them gives you temporary resistance.

lines.zh: 我在孤岛上徘徊，寻找我的归宿。
lines.en: I wander these islands in search of my home.

lines.zh: 荒凉的末地，孤独无伴，只有我。
lines.en: The desolate End, lonely without company, just me.

lines.zh: 我只能依靠自己的力量，探索这片孤岛。
lines.en: I must rely on my own strength to explore these islands.

lines.zh: 你的存在，让这片荒凉有了新的含义。
lines.en: Your existence gives this desolation a new meaning.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我就退回巨树阴影里。
lines.en: Turn your head, and I slip back into the great tree's shade.

lines.zh: 我数着你踩断的每一根枯枝。
lines.en: I count every dead twig you snap.

lines.zh: 别跑，末地的孤岛跑不了那么远。
lines.en: Don't run. These End islands don't go that far.

lines.zh: 你手里的斧头，砍不动我的执念。
lines.en: That axe won't cut through what keeps me walking.

lines.zh: 我枯了，可眼睛还认得活人。
lines.en: I'm withered, but these eyes still know the living.

lines.zh: 你身上的光，在灰色里太刺眼了。
lines.en: The light on you is too sharp against all this grey.

lines.zh: 我跟了你三座空岛，你没发觉。
lines.en: I followed you across three empty islands, and you never noticed.

lines.zh: 深呼吸吧，然后假装我不在这里。
lines.en: Breathe deep, then pretend I am not here.

lines.zh: 奄奄一息
lines.en: On the brink of death

lines.zh: 我是迁徙者留下的空壳。
lines.en: I'm the hollow left by a shifter.

lines.zh: 求生不得
lines.en: Screaming for survival

lines.zh: 衰弱乏力
lines.en: Fading fast

lines.zh: 我迁徙到这儿，已经走不动了。
lines.en: I migrated here and can go no further.

lines.zh: 濒死体验
lines.en: Taste of death

lines.zh: 生不如死
lines.en: Wish I were dead

lines.zh: 迁徙者的影子也会痛。
lines.en: Even a shifter's shadow hurts.

lines.zh: 劫数难逃
lines.en: Fated to die

lines.zh: 命不久矣
lines.en: Death's embrace

lines.zh: 这里没有友谊，只有孤独和恐惧。
lines.en: There's no friendship here, only loneliness and fear.

lines.zh: 但凡有生命的，都将逃不开我的视线。
lines.en: All life will escape my sight.

lines.zh: 我需要找到一个可以落脚的地方。
lines.en: I need to find a place to rest.

lines.zh: 我愿意接受你的挑战，看看你能否战胜我。
lines.en: I'm willing to accept your challenge and see if you can defeat me.

lines.zh: 但是，请不要试图靠近我，你只会被我的恐惧吞噬。
lines.en: But don't try to get close to me, you'll be consumed by my fear.

lines.zh: 我的力量来自于这片孤岛，我从未感到如此强大。
lines.en: My power comes from these islands, I've never felt so strong.

lines.zh: 在孤岛上，我学会了独自生存。
lines.en: On these islands, I learned to survive alone.

lines.zh: 你越是靠近，我越感觉到你的危险。
lines.en: The closer you get, the more danger you pose to me.

lines.zh: 或许我可以在这里找到一个新的开始。
lines.en: Perhaps I can find a new beginning here.

lines.zh: 但这里的一切，都是我最真实的存在。
lines.en: But everything here is my true self.

lines.zh: 我感到一阵剧痛，仿佛灵魂被撕扯。
lines.en: I feel a searing pain, as if my soul is being torn apart.

lines.zh: 这里，时间和规则都扭曲了，我被困在这里。
lines.en: Here, time and rules are warped, and I am trapped here.

lines.zh: 枯朽迁徙者，孤独而恐惧。
lines.en: Perished Shiftling, alone and afraid.

lines.zh: 每一步都像是在与命运抗争。
lines.en: Every step is a struggle against fate.

lines.zh: 这森林中的巨树，是最后的庇护。
lines.en: These forest giants are my last refuge.

lines.zh: 我害怕，我孤独。
lines.en: I am scared, I am alone.

lines.zh: 夜晚，恐怖将降临。
lines.en: Nightfall, terror will descend.

lines.zh: 我触摸不到现实的边缘。
lines.en: I can't touch the edge of reality.

lines.zh: 这里没有同伴，只有黑暗与寂静。
lines.en: There are no companions here, only darkness and silence.

lines.zh: 我只能等待，直到命运的终结。
lines.en: I can only wait for the end of fate.

lines.zh: 寻找同伴，是命运的召唤
lines.en: Seeking a mate, destiny's call

lines.zh: 我们是孤独的伴侣，永不分离
lines.en: We are companions in solitude, never to part

lines.zh: 半影下的爱情，最为坚韧
lines.en: Love in the Shadow Woods, the strongest

lines.zh: 与你，共享每一寸土地
lines.en: With you, share every inch of land

lines.zh: 枯朽，是我们的标记
lines.en: Decay, our sign

lines.zh: 在荒凉中，我们找到了彼此
lines.en: In the desolation, we found each other

lines.zh: 只有在彼此身边，我们才完整
lines.en: Only with each other, are we whole

lines.zh: 死亡的阴影下，我们永恒
lines.en: Under the shadow of death, we are eternal

lines.zh: 与你，共赴末日
lines.en: With you, to the end of the world

lines.zh: 孤独，但并不寂寞，因为有你
lines.en: Lonely, but not alone, with you

lines.zh: 我被遗弃在这孤岛上，寻找生存的可能。
lines.en: I'm abandoned on this deserted island, searching for a chance to survive.

lines.zh: 这里的树如此高大，我从未见过。
lines.en: The trees here are so tall, I've never seen anything like them before.

lines.zh: 我的手在颤抖，但必须采伐这坚硬的木材。
lines.en: My hands are trembling, but I must harvest this tough wood.

lines.zh: 我感到饥饿，发光的树叶或许能提供一些能量。
lines.en: I feel hungry, maybe those glowing leaves can provide some energy.

lines.zh: 这些岛屿间似乎有着某种联系。
lines.en: There seems to be some connection between these islands.

lines.zh: 我必须小心，这些树下的环境很危险。
lines.en: I must be careful, the environment under these trees is dangerous.

lines.zh: 我听到了什么声音，可能是个威胁。
lines.en: I heard something, it might be a threat.

lines.zh: 我在寻找资源，但不知道接下来会遇到什么。
lines.en: I'm looking for resources, but I never know what's next.

lines.zh: 我想要回家，但这片土地似乎并不欢迎我。
lines.en: I want to go home, but this land doesn't seem to welcome me.

lines.zh: 我必须尽快找到出路，这片末地荒凉之地已经让我不再感到恐惧。
lines.en: I must find a way out quickly, this desolate End has already stopped terrifying me.

lines.zh: 枯朽接近了.
lines.en: Perished approaches.

lines.zh: 阴影中的生物躁动.
lines.en: Creatures stir in the shadows.

lines.zh: 它注视着你.
lines.en: It stares at you.

lines.zh: 寒冷的空气弥漫.
lines.en: Chill fills the air.

lines.zh: 枯朽的呼吸声.
lines.en: Perished's breathing.

lines.zh: 远处的低语.
lines.en: Distant whispers.

lines.zh: 它的目光凶狠.
lines.en: Its gaze is fierce.

lines.zh: 警告你危险.
lines.en: Warns of danger.

lines.zh: 警惕它的存在.
lines.en: Be wary of it.

lines.zh: 它的出现不祥.
lines.en: Its arrival is ominous.

lines.zh: 枯朽的身子，还会往前挪。
lines.en: This withered body still shuffles forward.

lines.zh: 脚跟停住了，我该靠过去。
lines.en: Those heels stopped. Time to close in.

lines.zh: 枯枝断了一根，方向我记住了。
lines.en: A dead branch broke; I have your direction now.

lines.zh: 这具旧身体，还能追猎一次。
lines.en: This old body has one hunt left in it.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我已经换了位置。
lines.en: By the time you look back, I have moved.

lines.zh: 你落单了，末地没有旁观者。
lines.en: You're alone. The End keeps no bystanders.

lines.zh: 腐化行者出现
lines.en: Perished Shiftling appears

lines.zh: 空气中弥漫着腐朽
lines.en: Corruption permeates the air

lines.zh: 视线中的影子移动
lines.en: Shadows move in your line of sight

lines.zh: 尖利的爪子划破空气
lines.en: Sharp claws slice through the air

lines.zh: 逼近你的脚步声
lines.en: Footsteps approaching you

lines.zh: 寒冷的触感
lines.en: Chilling touch

lines.zh: 黑暗中闪现光芒
lines.en: Light flashes in the darkness

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中带着怒意
lines.en: Sibilant hiss with anger

lines.zh: 紧握手中的斧头
lines.en: Clasp the axe tightly

lines.zh: 感受他的视线
lines.en: Feel his gaze upon you

lines.zh: 我压着步子，一寸一寸逼近。
lines.en: I press forward, an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 朽木的味道，先一步飘到你身后。
lines.en: The smell of rot reaches your back before I do.

lines.zh: 别回头，我就在你的余光里。
lines.en: Don't turn around. I'm already in the corner of your eye.

lines.zh: 坚硬的木质磨着我的骨头。
lines.en: This hard wood grinds against my bones.

lines.zh: 你抬手的那刻，我已经贴上来。
lines.en: The moment you raise your hand, I'll be against you.

lines.zh: 孤岛这么小，你能躲到哪去。
lines.en: The island is small. Where exactly will you hide?

lines.zh: 我在等你的耐心先耗尽。
lines.en: I'm waiting for your patience to run out first.

lines.zh: 裂隙的风，会替我记住你的路。
lines.en: The wind through the gaps will remember your trail for me.

lines.zh: 枯朽迁徙者怒吼
lines.en: The Shiftling roars.

lines.zh: 腐朽之力加持
lines.en: Corruption strengthens you.

lines.zh: 靠近即死亡
lines.en: Death awaits the intruder.

lines.zh: 黑暗中寻找光亮
lines.en: Seek light in the darkness.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从暗处伸出来。
lines.en: My claws reach out of the dark.

lines.zh: 恐惧笼罩四周
lines.en: Fear surrounds you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声逼近
lines.en: Sibilant approach.

lines.zh: 痛苦吞噬灵魂
lines.en: Pain devours your soul.

lines.zh: 死亡之吻降临
lines.en: Death's kiss descends.

lines.zh: 哀嚎回荡天空
lines.en: Echoes of woe fill the skies.

lines.zh: 枯手扣进你的肩膀。
lines.en: My withered hand digs into your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一扑，用了我最后的气力。
lines.en: That lunge spent the last of my strength.

lines.zh: 朽骨撞上来，硌得生疼吧。
lines.en: Rotten bone hits hard, doesn't it.

lines.zh: 别怪我不讲道理，我早死了。
lines.en: Don't expect fairness from me. I died long ago.

lines.zh: 你比半影巨树软多了。
lines.en: You give way much easier than a gloomwood trunk.

lines.zh: 这是我仅剩的一点力气。
lines.en: This is all the force I have left.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗中寻找着出路，但每一步都像是在沼泽中挣扎。
lines.en: I search for a way out in the darkness, but every step feels like sinking in quicksand.

lines.zh: 这半影森林里的树，高得仿佛能触及天空，但我只能仰望它们。
lines.en: These trees in the twilight forest are so tall they almost touch the sky, but all I can do is gaze up at them.

lines.zh: 我的身体被这坚硬的木质所压迫，每一次呼吸都如此沉重。
lines.en: My body is oppressed by this hard wood, every breath feels so heavy.

lines.zh: 我的同伴们分散在这些孤岛之间，我们互相寻找，互相支援。
lines.en: My companions are scattered among these isolated islands, we look for each other, support each other.

lines.zh: 夜晚的阴影笼罩着这片荒凉之地，我只能在这微弱的光线下前行。
lines.en: The shadows of night cover this desolate land, I can only move in the faint light.

lines.zh: 我需要Endurian来维持我的力量，但它们却如此难以获得。
lines.en: I need Endurian to maintain my strength, but they are so hard to obtain.

lines.zh: 每次移动都像是在与这坚硬的木质对抗，我必须小心每一步。
lines.en: Every move feels like a struggle against this hard wood, I must be careful with each step.

lines.zh: 我渴望逃离这里的荒凉，哪怕只是一线生机。
lines.en: I yearn to escape this desolation, even if it’s just a flicker of hope.

lines.zh: 在这末地的孤岛之间，我找不到任何的归宿。
lines.en: In these isolated islands of the end, I can’t find any sense of belonging.

lines.zh: 我在寻找着任何能让我继续前行的东西，哪怕只是点点星光。
lines.en: I’m searching for anything that might allow me to keep moving forward, even just a flicker of starlight.

lines.zh: 我从倒下的巨树里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from under a fallen giant tree.

lines.zh: 末地的风把我吹上了这座孤岛。
lines.en: The End's wind blew me onto this lonely island.

lines.zh: 别的迁徙者都散了，只剩我。
lines.en: The other shiftlings scattered. Only I remain.

lines.zh: 发光树叶底下，我睡了很多年。
lines.en: I slept for years beneath the glowing leaves.

lines.zh: 枯朽的躯体，自己撑了起来。
lines.en: This rotted body pushed itself upright.

lines.zh: 暗处睁眼，末地又多一个影子。
lines.en: Eyes open in the dark: one more shadow in the End.

lines.zh: 孤岛之间没有桥，我一路爬来。
lines.en: There are no bridges between islands. I crawled the whole way.

lines.zh: 没人记得我是怎么来到这里的。
lines.en: No one remembers how I got here.

lines.zh: 燃烧了太久
lines.en: Burned for too long

lines.zh: 重重摔下
lines.en: Fell from great heights

lines.zh: 溺毙在虚无
lines.en: Drowned in the Void

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀散又聚拢。
lines.en: The blast scatters me, and I gather again.

lines.zh: 箭矢贯穿身躯
lines.en: Arrows pierced your flesh

lines.zh: 黑暗魔法侵袭
lines.en: Dark magic sears your soul

lines.zh: 饿死在废土
lines.en: Starved to death in the wasteland

lines.zh: 闪电从天而降
lines.en: Lightning struck from above

lines.zh: 虚空吞噬了你
lines.en: Consumed by the Void
